system.description:
You breathe a stream of Fire onto the target area which then expands into a ball of Fire burning all in its range. Select a point you can see as you breathe a stream of flame that expands into a ball of Fire filling a 10-foot radius sphere centering on the chosen point. All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6+4 Fire damage and 1 rank of Burned on a failed save or half as much damage on a success save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6+1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, flammable objects caught in the radius ignites if it isn’t being worn or carried. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can change this jutsu’s range to Self (60-Foot Line). If cast in this way the line is 10-feet wide. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can change this jutsu’s range to Self (60-Foot Cone)
